title: Grilled Quinoa Wrap
description: A flavorful and nutritious wrap filled with grilled quinoa and vegetables, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Heat agave in a pan over medium heat.
Add chopped leaf to the pan and sauté until wilted.
If desired, add grilled elements to the pan and stir to combine.
Warm the wrap in the pan for a few seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing the cooked quinoa mixture onto the center of the wrap.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
